text:
Is it true that, were I dead, you would feel

less life in yourself without mine?

That the sun would not shine as before,

knowing me in the night of the tomb?


What astonishment, my love, when I saw

all that in your letter! I am yours...

But... do I matter to you so much? How can I

serve you wine with my trembling hand?


I will renounce the dreams of death,

returning to the miseries of living.

Love me, love, your breath resurrects!


Others exchanged their rank for love,

and I for you the tomb, the heavenly

sweetness for earth here with you.

translation.title: Is It True That If I Were Dead You Would Feel
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the speaker's startled return from death-dreams into earthly love.
